intro: Beneath the rubble lies a badge bearing Theramore's sign, a golden anchor over white enamel, with the name Lieutenant Paval Reethe embossed under the anchor. Krog at Brackenwall Village is the one to bring it to.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: A glint of light on the ground catches your eye from underneath the rubble. Brushing debris and ash caked onto the object reveals the insignia of a gold anchor on white, enameled on the surface: the sign of Theramore.
Underneath the anchor is embossed the name "Lieutenant Paval Reethe".

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you found any leads on what happened at the Shady Rest Inn?

clips.title: Completion
paras: I know this human, Paval Reethe. Pathetic, even for his kind. He deserted his fellow soldiers and is now hiding out in the woods.
I sent Ogron out to track him down. Some of the others suspect he's been stealing from our supplies. I think I saw Ogron heading off to the southeast.
